name: coaching-calibration
description: Founder Calibration Workbench (Phase 3). Renders the DETERMINISTIC coach (five frozen engines) alongside the STRUCTURED coach (LLM narrator behind the provider seam) for the same real case, with a four-field observation logger. NOT a scoring system: no numeric rubric, no aggregation — raw side-by-side comparisons for the founder to calibrate judgment against. Reuses the evidence-shadow-compare two-column debugUI pattern; modifies no other package.
